name: Gemstone Guilds – Multiplayer Card Game Platform
description: Skill for the Gemstone Guilds project: a web-based multiplayer card game platform (Splendor and Dead Man's Draw) with React, Node.js, Socket.io, and PostgreSQL, according to SRS v1.0 (2026-04-29).

domain.summary: Gemstone Guilds is a web-based multiplayer card game platform that implements Splendor and Dead Man's Draw, with Solo (AI), online multiplayer, progression system (coins, gems, rank), shop, friends, groups, and a bilingual UI.

coreGames.name: Splendor
rulesSummary: Players collect gem tokens (diamond, sapphire, emerald, ruby, onyx, gold).
Initial token setup: for 2 players: 4 of each color, 5 gold; for 3 players: 5 of each color, 5 gold; for 4 players: 7 of each color, 5 gold.

On each turn, a player may perform exactly one of these actions: (1) take 3 tokens of different colors, or (2) take 2 tokens of the same color (if at least 4 tokens of that color are in the bank), or (3) purchase a visible card, or (4) reserve a card and gain 1 gold.
Cards provide: victory points (0–5), a permanent gem bonus, and a purchase cost (combination of gem types).
A Noble visits a player when they meet the required permanent bonuses.
The game ends when a player reaches 15 victory points; the winner is determined based on points (and official tie-breakers if needed).

coreGames.name: Dead Man's Draw
rulesSummary: Push-your-luck game: players draw treasure cards from a deck.
On their turn: draw a card (treasure + possibly a hazard). The player can choose to continue or stop.
If a duplicate hazard type is drawn, all current non-banked treasures are lost.
The game ends when the last treasure in the treasure area is collected and there are no cards left in the draw deck.
Winner: highest total of banked treasure points. If points are equal, the player with more cards wins; if both points and card counts are equal, all tied players win together.

gameModes.name: Solo / Single-player
gameModes.description: Play against AI at three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard.

aiRules.easy: Random valid moves with simple heuristics.
aiRules.medium: Balanced strategy considering card values and board state.
aiRules.hard: Advanced strategy with lookahead and game state evaluation.

gameModes.name: Online Multiplayer
gameModes.description: Real-time multiplayer using Socket.io, 5-coin entry fee, real-time synchronization and in-game chat.

gameModes.name: Challenge Modes
gameModes.description: Daily Puzzle, Bot Survival, Turn Limit (some not fully implemented yet).

rank.splendorPrestigeContribution: Each Splendor card generates prestige points which are factored into rank.

frontendStructure.stateManagement: Centralized game state (e.g., Zustand, Redux, or context + reducer) for managing GameState and Socket.io events.

backendStructure.sockets: Use Socket.io for game rooms, events such as: join_room, leave_room, game_state_update, player_action, chat_message, reconnect.

namingConventions.files: kebab-case for files, PascalCase for components, camelCase for variables/functions.

notes: Passwords should be hashed with bcrypt (minimum 10 rounds).
Sessions stored with httpOnly cookies and secure tokens.
language: 'en' | 'fa' and for 'fa', UI must switch to RTL.

requirements: All UI text must be internationalized (en/fa).
Layout must be RTL in 'fa' mode (appropriate flex-direction and text-align).
Error messages and toast notifications must be localized.
Group name must be at least 5 characters.
Leader can disband the group (if no games are currently active).

splendor.winCondition: First player to reach 15 points, then resolve the round and determine the winner.

deadMansDraw.winCondition: Highest total banked treasure; tie-break by number of cards; shared victory possible.

aiAssistance.avoidCheating: AI should only use allowed (non-hidden) information.

errorHandling.invalidActionMessage: When an action is illegal, return a clear error message.
